title: Periodic access certification flow + SCIM delta reconciliation for compliance evidence
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an automated access certification workflow and harden SCIM provisioning reconciliation to produce tamper-evident compliance artifacts. This work ties RBAC role snapshots, SSO/SAML provisioning events, and periodic manager attestations together into a single evidence bundle that satisfies auditors for data residency and retention requirements. It includes: (1) SCIM delta reconciler to detect deprovisioning failures within 24 hours, (2) scheduled access certification campaigns (quarterly + on-demand) with manager attestations and escalations, (3) immutable evidence export with configurable retention zones tied to customer data-residency settings, and (4) reporting endpoints and dashboard tiles for compliance teams to download CSV/JSON bundles and verify completion rates.
acceptance_criteria: SCIM reconciler detects and reports any delta (missing user, group mismatches, failed PATCH/DELETE) within 24 hours and creates a ticket in the compliance queue when auto-remediate fails

Access certification UI triggers campaigns scoped by team, org, role, or custom SCIM group; managers receive email + Console notification to attest; attestations recorded with timestamp and operator identity

Evidence bundle contains: RBAC role snapshot (versioned), SCIM delta log, SAML assertion hash, attestation records, and audit-log slice; bundle is signed and stored in customer residency zone with retention metadata
Exported evidence bundles are immutable, downloadable (CSV+JSON+signed manifest), and purged only according to retention policy associated with the customer residency setting
Admin report endpoint provides per-campaign completion percentage, outstanding attestations, and reconciliation error counts with <5% false positives in synthetic tests

Automated unit + e2e tests for reconciler and attestation flow exist and are run in CI; performance test shows reconciler can process 10k user deltas per minute without crossing latency SLOs for critical realtime routes
tasks: Design SCIM delta reconciler algorithm and failure modes (PRD link: https://drive.google.com/example-scim-design)
Implement reconciler job: snapshot -> diff -> reconcile -> escalate
Add attestation UI flows and API endpoints; wire email/console notifications
Create evidence bundle format (signed manifest + retention metadata); implement storage adapters for us-east-1, eu-west-1
Add retention enforcement job and residency-aware purging rules
Create admin reporting API and Console tiles; add data-model indices for campaign queries
Write CI tests and run load tests; add observability (metrics + traces + alerting)
Prepare runbook and add to compliance documentation; coordinate with Legal for audit language
